controller.quote: This privacy notice describes what personal information the Python Software Foundation (“PSF”) collects from users, when and how we share that information, and why.

purposes.quote: We use the information you provide in the following ways, in addition to the uses described in the PSF Privacy Notice: To provide the website to you

recipients.quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) to host the PyCon US website. We store your registration information on AWS servers.

notes: Controller only implied (PSF collects); no explicit controller wording. Rights, retention, transfers, contact, legal basis are in the separate PSF Privacy Notice, not in this text.
